openai/gpt-oss-120b.description: Default — the model used in ai&'s own quickstart curl example (https://docs.aiand.com/, retrieved 2026-09-28): 'curl https://api.aiand.com/v1/chat/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-your-api-key" -d {"model": "openai/gpt-oss-120b", ...}'. Vendor description (GET /v1/models, 2026-09-28): "Open GPT reasoning model for self-hosted agents and controllable deployments". Cheapest model on the roster. Documents `reasoning` + `tool_calling` capabilities and a `reasoning_effort` request parameter with model-specific values low/medium/high (default medium) — see https://docs.aiand.com/api/chat-completions/. No `vision` capability listed, so image/video input is expected to be rejected. Docs- and roster-verified only — no API key was used, so no live chat/stream/tool call was made against this or any other model in this catalog.

zai-org/glm-5.3.description: Vendor description (GET /v1/models, 2026-09-28): "Flagship GLM model for long-horizon coding, agents, and complex project delivery". reasoning_effort values low/high/max, default max. 1M context. Roster-listed and priced only, not itself capability-probed; fallback.

zai-org/glm-5.2.description: Vendor description (GET /v1/models, 2026-09-28): "Open flagship GLM for long-horizon coding agents and million-token context work". reasoning_effort values none/high/max, default max. Roster-listed only; fallback.

deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-pro.description: Vendor description (GET /v1/models, 2026-09-28): "Open MoE flagship with million-token context for coding and long agent runs". reasoning_effort values none/high/max, default none. Roster-listed only; fallback.

deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-flash.description: Vendor description (GET /v1/models, 2026-09-28): "Fast DeepSeek V4 lane for economical reasoning, coding, and long-context work". reasoning_effort values none/high/max, default none. Roster-listed only; fallback.

moonshotai/kimi-k3.description: Vendor description (GET /v1/models, 2026-09-28): "Multimodal Kimi model with 1M context and toggleable max-effort thinking for long-horizon agent work". reasoning_effort values low/high/max, default max. Lists `vision` in its capabilities array, but ai&'s vision docs (https://docs.aiand.com/capabilities/vision/) describe images/video as uploaded via the Files API first and referenced by `file_id` — not the inline base64 `image_url` data-URI shape NeuroLink's other providers use — and that flow was not exercised (no key used). Roster-listed only; fallback.

moonshotai/kimi-k2.7-code.description: Vendor description (GET /v1/models, 2026-09-28): "Coding-focused Kimi model, stronger on long-horizon repo work with less overthinking". reasoning_effort fixed to high (only value listed). Lists `vision`; see the kimi-k3 note above on ai&'s Files-API-based image/video flow being unverified here. Roster-listed only; fallback.

qwen/qwen3.8-27b.description: Vendor description (GET /v1/models, 2026-09-28): "Dense 27B vision-language model for coding, agent tasks, and image and video understanding". reasoning_effort values none/low/medium/xhigh, default medium. Lists `vision`; see the kimi-k3 note above on ai&'s Files-API-based image/video flow being unverified here. Roster-listed only; fallback.

qwen/qwen3.6-27b.description: Vendor description (GET /v1/models, 2026-09-28): "Qwen vision-language model for visual reasoning, documents, and agent tasks". reasoning_effort values none/high, default high. Lists `vision`; see the kimi-k3 note above on ai&'s Files-API-based image/video flow being unverified here. Roster-listed only; fallback.

motif-technologies/motif-3.description: Vendor description (GET /v1/models, 2026-09-28): "Motif 3 is a large-scale, decoder-only Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 314 billion total parameters and 13.2 billion parameters activated per token." reasoning_effort values none/high, default high. Roster-listed only; fallback.

google/gemma-4-31b-it.description: Vendor description (GET /v1/models, 2026-09-28): "Largest Gemma 4 instruction model for open, self-hosted chat and reasoning". reasoning_effort values none/high, default none. Lists `vision`; see the kimi-k3 note above on ai&'s Files-API-based image/video flow being unverified here. Roster-listed only; fallback.

instructions: 1. Visit: https://console.aiand.com/playground and sign in (Google, GitHub, or a magic-link email — https://docs.aiand.com/authentication/)
2. Create an organization API key under Organizations → API Keys (https://docs.aiand.com/organizations/api-keys/) — shown in full only once, and starts with sk-
3. ai& is prepaid only, no free tier: add credits via Stripe Checkout before making requests (https://docs.aiand.com/billing/credits/) — a zero balance returns HTTP 402 until credits are added
setup.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api.aiand.com/v1 (also exposes Anthropic-shaped /v1/messages, a Responses endpoint, and legacy Completions), serving zai-org GLM, Qwen, Kimi (moonshotai), DeepSeek V4, Google Gemma 4, Motif-3 and OpenAI gpt-oss open-weight models, each with a documented per-model `reasoning_effort` control. Prepaid credit billing only — no free tier; failed requests are not billed.
